name: Glyceryl monolaurate
assumptions: Pure primary (1-)monoester; two remaining OH on adjacent carbons. Commercial mono-/diglyceride mixtures are not this molecule.

name: Glyceryl monopalmitate
assumptions: Pure primary (1-)monoester; two remaining OH on adjacent carbons. Commercial mono-/diglyceride mixtures are not this molecule.

name: Glyceryl monostearate
assumptions: Pure primary (1-)monoester; two remaining OH on adjacent carbons. Commercial mono-/diglyceride mixtures are not this molecule.

name: Glyceryl monooleate
assumptions: Pure primary monoester of cis-oleic acid; not a mixed oleate grade.

name: Propylene glycol monostearate
assumptions: Primary monoester, one free OH; commercial isomers/diesters not included.

name: Diglyceryl monostearate
assumptions: One linear primary monoester of alpha,alpha-prime diglycerol; two adjacent OH and one isolated OH. Grade oligomer/isomer distribution must be supplied.

name: Sorbitan monolaurate
assumptions: Ideal 1,4-sorbitan 6-monoester: one ring ether; free OH at C2/C3/C5. Commercial sorbitan esters contain isomers and other esterification levels.

name: Sorbitan monopalmitate
assumptions: Ideal 1,4-sorbitan 6-monoester: one ring ether; free OH at C2/C3/C5. Commercial sorbitan esters contain isomers and other esterification levels.

name: Sorbitan monostearate
assumptions: Ideal 1,4-sorbitan 6-monoester: one ring ether; free OH at C2/C3/C5. Commercial sorbitan esters contain isomers and other esterification levels.

name: Sorbitan monooleate
assumptions: Ideal 1,4-sorbitan 6-monoester: one ring ether; free OH at C2/C3/C5. Commercial sorbitan esters contain isomers and other esterification levels.

name: PEG-2 monostearate
assumptions: Pure monoester with exactly 2 oxyethylene units; one free terminal OH. Commercial PEG distributions and diesters excluded.

name: PEG-8 monostearate
assumptions: Pure monoester with exactly 8 oxyethylene units; one free terminal OH. Commercial PEG distributions and diesters excluded.

name: Laureth-2
assumptions: Linear pure C12 alcohol ethoxylate with exactly 2 EO units; one terminal OH, not a commercial homolog distribution.

name: Laureth-4
assumptions: Linear pure C12 alcohol ethoxylate with exactly 4 EO units; one terminal OH, not a commercial homolog distribution.

name: Laureth-7
assumptions: Linear pure C12 alcohol ethoxylate with exactly 7 EO units; one terminal OH, not a commercial homolog distribution.

name: Steareth-2
assumptions: Linear pure C18 alcohol ethoxylate with exactly 2 EO units; one terminal OH, not a commercial homolog distribution.

name: Sorbitan monolaurate + 20 EO
assumptions: Ideal single-ring monoester with exactly 20 added EO units across all three free OH arms; three isolated terminal OH remain. Not an exact commercial polysorbate composition.

name: Sorbitan monostearate + 20 EO
assumptions: Ideal single-ring monoester with exactly 20 added EO units across all three free OH arms; three isolated terminal OH remain. Not an exact commercial polysorbate composition.

name: Sorbitan monooleate + 20 EO
assumptions: Ideal single-ring monoester with exactly 20 added EO units across all three free OH arms; three isolated terminal OH remain. Not an exact commercial polysorbate composition.
